user.description: Set up Weather.com integration. Follow the instructions in the GitHub README to get an API key.

coordinates.description: Enter the geographical coordinates to use for the weather forecast.

entity.description: Select a Home Assistant tracking entity or zone to pull coordinates from.

reconfigure.description: Reconfigure the Weather.com integration. You can change the API key, name, language, or location source.

error.invalid_api_key: The API key is invalid. Please check your credentials.
error.invalid_location_entity: The selected location does not have valid latitude and longitude attributes.
error.unknown_error: An unexpected error occurred while connecting to Weather.com. Check the Home Assistant logs for more details.

abort.already_configured: A Weather.com integration with this name already exists. Please choose a different name.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The Weather.com integration was reconfigured successfully.
